# Description

Each QPress simulation runs until it produces 10,000 stable matrices. The object produced by QPress' `system.simulate` records the total number of matrices produced to reach 10,000 stable ones. 

Compare the % total matrices that were stable (**"% stable matrices"**) across operating model scenarios (OMs) x management strategies (HCRs).

Hypothesis: The OMs / HCRs which showed the least agreement between the quantitative MSE and QNMs will have the lowest % matrices that were stable.  



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)
library(QPress)
library(janitor)
library(kableExtra)

## let's time things
end.timer <- function(s){round(Sys.time()-s,2)}

## read in which version of the data from qpress?
sim.date <- '20240923' 

```

## Data

Read in the output from perturbations
`system.simulate` output should have been saved as lists from qnm_mse_master.R
```{r load_sims, echo=TRUE}
s <- Sys.time()

hcrA_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrA_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))
hcrB_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrB_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))
hcrC_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrC_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))
hcrD_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrD_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))
hcrE_out <- readRDS(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('mse0-5_hcrE_10K_',sim.date,'.rds')))

hcr_out_all <- list(hcrA_out,hcrB_out,hcrC_out,hcrD_out,hcrE_out)
names(hcr_out_all) <- c("A","B","C","D","E")

end.timer(s)
```
